firm_data.firm_description: Simon Greenstone Panatier, PC is a national trial firm dedicated to fighting for clients’ rights in serious injury cases. They represent individuals and families harmed by negligence and recklessness, particularly involving large corporations.
notable_facts: Jeffrey Simon and David Greenstone were selected among Lawdragon’s Leading Lawyers for 2026.
The firm has earned Best Law Firms recognition for its plaintiffs work.
The firm offers a scholarship benefiting families impacted by cancer.

email.subject: AI for Simon Greenstone Panatier, PC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Christi,

Jeffrey Simon and David Greenstone's selection among Lawdragon's Leading Lawyers for 2026 reflects the caliber of trial work your firm delivers in mesothelioma and catastrophic injury cases. That kind of national reputation on serious injury matters requires precision, and it also means managing significant complexity across cases and clients.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Dallas to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, document review, and case strategy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
